name: GRC International Group plc
summary: GRC International Group plc, through its subsidiaries, provides various products and services to address the information technology (IT) governance, risk management, and compliance requirements of organizations in the United Kingdom, rest of Europe, the United States, Australia, and internationally. The company provides instructor-led and self-paced training courses on data protection, cyber security, ISO 27001 certification, and business continuity. It also offers on-site and remote support services to design and implement cyber security, data protection and privacy policies, procedures and practices, penetration testing, payment card industry data security standard, SoC2 compliance and cyber essentials certification and consultancy, privacy by design, privacy as a service, and GDPR compliance. In addition, publishes and distributes books, toolkit documentation templates, and software; and software solutions including a range of software-as-a service products, such as e-learning, risk assessment and data flow mapping tools, data seeding, and data watermarking solutions. GRC International Group plc is headquartered in Ely, the United Kingdom.
